text: Peace be with you, child. Come in out of the {weather}.
Mother Celestine. Saint Vesper's door is always open, to anyone, for anything.
You look tired, {player}. Sit. Let me look at you.
I know your face from the posters. Sanctuary is sanctuary. Come in.
There's salt in your breath, child. The sea has hold of you. Sit, and I'll pray for both of you.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.

options.label: Why does the bell ring at dusk?

text: Saint Vesper. A cathedral, an infirmary, a graveyard, and more prayers than anywhere else in the Reach.
Brother Anselm makes tonics by the stall. Sister Odile keeps the market. The rest of us pray and sweep.
Every dusk, one toll for every ship lost that day. Some days it rings once. Some days it rings until the stars are out.
Listen. It's about to start.
That nobody is past mending. Not the drowned, not pirates, not governors. Though I confess governors try my faith.
